meeting.summary: Discussion only; no action taken. City Manager Ben Reeves and Director of Legislative and Strategic Affairs Evan Berrett led a session on a new city vision. Councilmembers Whiting and Huish offered a draft, and the council finalized this Vision Statement: "Eagle Mountain City is creating the most distinct way of life, honoring our rural heritage and cultivating unparalleled open space and recreation, powered by building the most prosperous community in Utah County." The council then brainstormed priorities under five proposed Focus Areas (Citizen Experience, Stewardship, Essential Services, Regional Partnerships, Economic Prosperity) and asked that the vision and focus areas go to city departments for feedback before a future meeting sets Council Priorities.

resolutions.line_text: 2.A. RESOLUTION – DISCUSSION ONLY/NO ACTION - Strategic Planning
